title: Cladding Spec
description: Minimal v0.1 SSoT schema. Captures 3-tier shape (scenarios + features + architecture) and EARS-structured AC. See ironclad-design/07 + 11.

description.description: One-line summary of what the project is for. Used as the spec.yaml 'front door' hint.

version.description: Current project version (e.g. '0.3.49'). Free-form; typically matches package.json or pyproject.toml.

intent_summary.description: TL;DR of docs/project-context.md. One sentence answering 'what problem does this project solve?'.

require_oracles.description: Opt-in: when true, every done AC must declare oracle_refs (SPEC_CONFORMANCE MANDATORY rule, EXHAUSTIVE). Default falsy. Superseded by oracle_policy when present.

oracle_policy.description: Risk-weighted oracle requirement. Takes precedence over require_oracles. Done ACs whose EARS category is in always_ears, plus a deterministic `sample` fraction of the rest, must declare oracle_refs. Absent = no mandate; require_oracles:true = exhaustive (sample 1.0).

always_ears.description: EARS categories whose done ACs ALWAYS require an oracle (high-risk). Defaults to ['unwanted'] when omitted.

sample.description: Deterministic fraction [0,1] of the remaining (non-always_ears) done ACs that also require an oracle. 0 = only always_ears; 1 = exhaustive.

deliverable.description: The project's runnable entry point. DELIVERABLE_SMOKE (stage_2.4) executes it on smoke_args once a feature is done — but only when is_safe_to_smoke is true. The pure DELIVERABLE_INTEGRITY detector flags a declared-but-missing path.

path.description: Executable entry path relative to the project root (e.g. './run'). Must be directly runnable or an interpreter.

smoke_args.description: Args passed to the entry for the smoke run (e.g. ['--version']). Default [].

expect_exit.description: Exit code that means success. Default 0.

timeout_ms.description: Hard timeout for the smoke run in ms. Default 5000.

is_safe_to_smoke.description: The gate executes the entry only when true (author vouches running it on smoke_args has no harmful side effects). Default false ⇒ skipped.

smoke.description: Functional smoke probes (F-g'). The gate RE-EXECUTES each: a cli probe whose stdout contains expect.token reads PASS (green); an exit-only probe (no token) reads LIVENESS (non-green); kind:none reads N/A. Honest spine: stages/disposition.ts.

kind.description: cli = run argv and assert; none = nothing to run (library/static) ⇒ N/A.

run.description: argv for kind:cli (no shell); cwd = project root.

exit.description: Exit code that means success. Default 0.

token.description: AC-observable token the deliverable must emit on stdout. Present + matched ⇒ green PASS; absent ⇒ exit-only LIVENESS (non-green).

feature.description: F-id this probe is bound to (F-4ef09f38). Bound to a not-done feature ⇒ na (argv not executed); bound to a done feature ⇒ executes regardless of the project-global done gating; a dangling id ⇒ SMOKE_PROBE_DEMAND warns. Omitted ⇒ project-global anyDone gating.

why.description: Why this probe proves the AC (Why>What).

ai_hints.description: Optional behavior guidance for AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) that load this spec.yaml at session start.

preferred_persona.description: Which persona prompt to load by default (e.g. 'planner', 'developer', 'reviewer', 'observability', 'orchestrator').

token_budget_per_session.description: DEPRECATED 0.6.0 (F-b43066): never had a runtime consumer; no longer written by init/clarify. Accepted for backward compatibility; removal in 0.7. Soft cap on tokens a single AI session should consume on this project.

primary_branch.description: Branch new feature work should target by default (e.g. 'develop', 'main').

forbidden_patterns.description: Identifier substrings the AI should refuse to introduce (e.g. 'eval', 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML', 'exec(').

preferred_patterns.description: Domain-relevant patterns the AI agent should prefer. Each entry is a {when, prefer, over?} triple — advisory only (no detector enforcement). v0.3.58+ (F-32b1e0).

when.description: Context where the preference applies (e.g. 'React state management').

over.description: Pattern to avoid in favor of `prefer` (e.g. 'this.state, class components').

capabilities.description: Tier-B capabilities merged from spec/capabilities.yaml — user-facing/platform groupings that features[] implement.

inventory.description: Auto-maintained shard counts. `clad sync` rewrites this block on every run. Provides 1-file lookup for AI agents asking 'how big is this spec?'.

capabilities.description: Count of capabilities entries in spec/capabilities.yaml.

last_synced.description: Legacy — no longer written (F-6e49fd24). Accepted so spec.yaml files from older versions still validate.

test_refs.description: Concrete code-test paths that verify this AC (e.g. tests/foo.test.ts). Restrict to executable test files; non-test evidence belongs in evidence_refs.

oracle_refs.description: Impl-blind spec-conformance oracle file path(s), expected under tests/oracle/. Resolved on disk by SPEC_CONFORMANCE; required for done ACs when project.require_oracles is set.

evidence_refs.description: Non-test verification artifacts: npm scripts (script:NAME or self-dogfood:NAME), conformance fixtures (fixture:NAME), docs (path/to.md), or measurement reports. Satisfies the MISSING_TESTS detector alongside test_refs.
